scope: Goal-focused, at the user's direction: ss 86(1)-(2), 95(1), 97(1)-(5), 108, 111(1)-(3), 119-122, 135(1)(a), 136(1), 140(1), 141, 145(2), (5)-(6), 155, 162(1)-(3), 163(2), 164, 207B, 211(1), 227(1) of the revised text as at 29 July 2026. Inputs: date of birth, start of continuous employment, a week's pay, how and when the contract ended, tribunal findings, early conciliation dates. Left out on purpose: Parts I-VIII, the s 98 fairness test, the compensatory award, lay-off, continuity rules, the calculation of a week's pay (see NOTES.md).

not_reviewed.note: No domain expert has read this against the Act. An independent test pass was run on 2026-10-18 (tests-independent.l4, 148 assertions; 143 from expectations written before the encoding was read, 5 probes after). Five failed — years counted back across 29 February (F4) and s 207B(3) stopping days outside the period (F14) — and the encoding was corrected. Dates are computed as the Act words them, with no working-day rule. The pipeline has not been run.

forks.F1: s 86 notice of w weeks given on d expires d + 7w; service measured on the day notice is given.
forks.F2: 'n months beginning with x' ends the day before the corresponding date, or the month's last day if none.
forks.F3: Two years ending with E: E on or after the last day of the 24 months beginning with the start.
forks.F4: Years reckoned back: year k begins on the later of (e − k years) + 1 day and (e + 1 day) − k years.
forks.F5: Age band: 41 (or 22) reached by the first day of the year of employment.
forks.F6: s 97(4) extends for the employee terminating; s 145(5) has no such limb.
forks.F7: s 97(2)/145(5): s 86 length measured at the material date; none under one month.
forks.F8: s 111(2)(a) and s 164(1) run from the s 97(1)/145(2) dates.
forks.F9: s 164(2) runs from the day after the s 164(1) period; s 207B extends (1)(c) and (2) only.
forks.F10: s 163(2): redundancy presumed when not proved either way.
forks.F11: s 120 minimum applied before s 122 reductions; s 121 replaces s 119.
forks.F13: s 111(3): complaint on or after the day notice is given and before the EDT.
forks.F14: s 207B(3): only conciliation days within the period counted by the limit are stopped.
